answer: The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 10 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. Because the violet beacon round is committed in advance, the lantern audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the beacon value does not exist until the window has already shut. That is 4 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
